data.fund_name: Franklin India Life Stage Fund of Funds - 20s Plan
data.fund_type: Open ended fund of fund scheme investing in funds which in turn invest in equity and debt
data.investment_objective: The primary objective is to generate superior risk adjusted returns to investors in line with their chosen asset allocation.
data.asset_allocation: Equity - 80%; Debt - 20% However, depending on the assessment of the market based on parameters such as the prevailing market valuations etc., the portfolio manager may make a tactical change in asset allocation within the following range: Equity -70% to 90%; Debt - 10% to 30% Details of Asset Allocation between equity and debt schemes are as follows: Equity: 80% -FIBCF: Up to 80%; FIPF: Up to 25%; TIVF: Up to 25%; Debt: 20% - FIDA: Up to 20%; FICDF: Up to 20% The steady state asset allocation will be as shown below: FIBCF: 50%, FIPF: 15%, TIVF: 15%, FIDA: 10%, FICDF: 10%
data.benchmark: 65% S&P BSE Sensex + 15% Nifty 500 + 20% Crisil Composite Bond Fund Index
data.exit_load: 1% if redeemed within 1 year of allotment
